# NVDA Financial Performance Summary

NVDA delivered exceptional growth across all major metrics through FY2026, with revenue reaching $215.9B (+65.5% YoY) and net income surging to $120.1B (+64.7% YoY). The company strengthened its balance sheet by reducing long-term debt to $7.5B (-11.7% YoY) while maintaining robust cash generation of $102.7B in operating cash flow.

## Revenue and Profitability

Revenue grew to $215.9B in FY2026, up +65.5% from $130.5B in FY2025. Operating income reached $130.4B (+60.1% YoY), while net income climbed to $120.1B (+64.7% YoY). This represents sustained momentum from FY2025, when revenue doubled at +114.2% and net income surged +144.9%.

## Cash Generation and Balance Sheet

Operating cash flow reached $102.7B in FY2026, up +60.3% from $64.1B in FY2025. Cash on hand increased to $10.6B (+23.5% YoY), while long-term debt declined to $7.5B (-11.7% YoY), reflecting improved financial flexibility.

## Share Count

Diluted shares outstanding decreased to 24.51B in FY2026 from 24.80B in FY2025 (-1.2% YoY), continuing a modest downward trend from FY2025's -0.5% decline.

## Caveats

FY2024 diluted shares were restated due to a stock split, affecting year-over-year comparability for that metric.
